name: Enchanted Forest
description: A night in the enchanted woods: a winding trail loops round the forest (the old cobbled road cuts across it), with detours to the witch's log cabin, her stone circle, the old ruins, a pumpkin patch, a little graveyard and an abandoned campsite. Lanterns light the trail (some smashed), iron lamps line the road, and a crash has blocked half of it. Wrong Turn.
